description_en: Queries task information such as task status and filtering policies for a video purge or prefetch task
description_zh: 调用本接口查询视频刷新或预热任务的任务状态、筛选策略等任务信息
name: GetMediaRefreshJobs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the audio or video purge or prefetch task. This is the value of MediaRefreshJobId returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 音/视频刷新或预热的任务ID，为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html接口返回参数MediaRefreshJobId的值
parameters.name: media_refresh_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The audio or video ID, which is the `MediaIds` value specified when calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html operation. Only one audio or video ID can be specified.

If this parameter is not specified, task information for all audio or video files under the specified `MediaRefreshJobId` is returned. If this parameter is specified, only the task information for the specified audio or video ID under the `MediaRefreshJobId` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频ID，为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html时传入的0，只能设置一个音/视频ID。

若不传入本参数，则查询`MediaRefreshJobId`下所有音/视频的任务信息；若传入本参数，则只查询`MediaRefreshJobId`下该音/视频ID所对应的任务信息
parameters.name: media_id

MediaRefreshJobs.description_en: The list of audio or video purge or prefetch task information
MediaRefreshJobs.description_zh: 音/视频刷新或预热任务信息列表

items.description_en: The details of the audio or video purge or prefetch task
items.description_zh: 音/视频刷新或预热任务详情

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This field is returned when the purge or prefetch task fails to be submitted
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。
当提交刷新或预热任务失败时会有该字段

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. This field is returned when the purge or prefetch task fails to be submitted
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。
当提交刷新或预热任务失败时会有该字段
ErrorMessage.example: Preload queue is full, please try again later!

FilterPolicy.description_en: The filtering policy for playback streams. The value is in JSON format and contains the request parameters of the [SubmitMediaRefreshJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html） operation
FilterPolicy.description_zh: 播放流的筛选策略。JSON格式，内容为[提交音视频刷新或预热任务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/431095.html）接口的请求参数

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the task was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the task was last modified

MediaRefreshJobId.description_en: The ID of the audio or video purge or prefetch task
MediaRefreshJobId.description_zh: 音/视频刷新或预热的任务ID

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
success: succeeded
fail: failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
success：成功
fail：失败

SuccessPlayUrls.description_en: The playback URLs that were successfully purged or prefetched
SuccessPlayUrls.description_zh: 成功被刷新或预热的播放URL

TaskIds.description_en: The task IDs for the purge or prefetch of playback URLs. Each URL corresponds to one task ID. You can use the task ID to call the [DescribeVodRefreshTasks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69214.html） operation to query the purge or prefetch status of each playback URL
TaskIds.description_zh: 播放URL的刷新或预热的任务ID，一个URL对应一个任务ID。该任务ID用于[DescribeVodRefreshTasks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69214.html）接口查询每个播放URL的刷新或预热状态

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
Refresh: purge
Preload: prefetch
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：
Refresh：刷新
Preload：预热

UserData.description_en: The UserData information specified when the purge or prefetch task was submitted
UserData.description_zh: 提交刷新或预热任务时传入的UserData信息
